nodes.title: Decompose rational functions into partial fractions (denominators not more complicated than repeated linear terms). Coordinate geometry in the (x, y) plane: • Partial fractions to include denominators such as (ax + b)(cx + d)(ex + f) and (ax + b)(cx + d)². The degree of the numerator may equal or exceed the degree of the denominator. Applications to integration, differentiation and series expansions. Quadratic factors in the denominator such as (x² + a), a > 0, are not required.
